RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the March 17, 2008/Phalguna 27, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development;
Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy;
Power; Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs;
Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
75
Restructuring of APDRP
†*241. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to launch a new Accelerated
Power Development and Reforms
Programme (APDRP-II), after the failure
of Accelerated Power Development and
Reforms Programme (APDRP);
(b) if so, the targets proposed to be
fixed thereunder;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
targets proposed under this programme
have been declared unrealistic by the
Planning Commission; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Report of National Commission for
Scheduled Castes
*242. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA: Will the
Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Commission for Scheduled Castes has
submitted its report to Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the recommendations of the report?
 Setting up of an institute of studies
in Sri Guru Granth Sahib
*243. SHRI TARLOCHAN SINGH:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during his
visit to Amritsar, the Prime Minister had
made a public announcement for setting up
of an institute of studies on Sri Guru Granth
Sahib in that city;
(b) whether it is also a fact that, for two
years, various Departments of the
Ministry have held many meetings to
finalize the project;
(c) whether the land for this project was
being given free by the Guru Nanak Dev
University, Amritsar;
(d) what is the fate of this project, which
is lingering on for three years; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

76
(e) whether the Prime Minister would
honour his announcement?
 ST status for Gujjars
†*244. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI:
DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA:
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a high level Committee had
been set up, under the Chairmanship of
Justice Shri Jasraj Chopra, to consider the
demand of Gujjars, after the agitation for
Gujjar reservation in Rajasthan;
(b) whether the report of the Committee
has been sent to the Central Government
by the Rajasthan Government;
(c) if so, the main recommendations of
the Committee, alongwith the action being
taken thereon; and
(d) whether Justice Chopra has stated
that the norms for giving Scheduled Tribe
status are no longer applicable and are
required to be reconsidered?
 Reservation for SCs/STs in private
sector
*245. SHRI BHAGIRATHI MAJHI:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether private companies follow
reservation policy for SCs/STs, with regard
to appointment for technical/non-technical
posts in their companies;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
names of companies following these norms;
(c) if not, whether Government would
give any direction about it; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Employment for disabled in private
sector
*246. SHRI T.T.V . DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is proposed to provide
incentives to private sector, to employ
physically challenged persons;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reaction of the private sector
thereto?
 ICDS in a mission mode
*247. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Minister has declared
that the Integrated Child Development
Services Scheme has been put in a mission
mode in the Eleventh Five Year Plan;
(b) if so, whether Government was
contemplating some kind of accreditation
to NGOs and also ratings and incentives,
to motivate them to do good work by 2020;
(c) whether India would emerge as the
youngest population in the world and the
mandate for the Ministry was to prepare
the nation to achieve excellence; and
(d) if so, which other schemes, the
Ministry is considering to improve the child
plans in the country?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

77
 Adoption of orphan children
†*248. SHRI AJAY MAROO:
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the existing provisions
regarding adoption of orphan children;
(b) whether it is a fact that difficulty is
being faced in adopting such children due
to legal complexities;
(c) whether there is any proposal to
reconsider the laws regarding adoption;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Running of orphanages
†*249. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
both registered and unregistered
organizations are running orphanages;
(b) whether certain cases of supplying
children for sexual exploitation by the
people running these orphanages have come
to the notice of Government; and
(c) if so, the measures being taken by
Government to prevent such incidents and
for the safety of children?
 Campus selections in IITs and IIMs
*250. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that corporates
and multi-nationals are making campus
selections in IITs and IIMs, by offering
attractive salaries and perks;
(b) if so, the details of direct selection
made by them during 2006 and 2007; and
(c) the steps being taken to bring in
brilliant talent into public services?
 Improvement of hydro-electric power
generation
†*251. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the share of hydel power
capacity has decreased in the total power
generation capacity of the country, due to
shortfall in the hydel power generation;
(b) whether the States having high
potential have also failed badly in
exploitation of this sector and even the
initiatives of the private sector too have
shown very little success; and
(c) if so, the details of steps and
measures Government proposes to take to
improve hydel power generation in the
country?
 Committee of Ministers on Dalit
Affairs
*252. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the sixteen
member Committee of Ministers on Dalit
Affairs, headed by the Minister of External
Affairs, has met only once a year since
2005;
(b) if so, the issues pertaining to the
Dalit Community that remain on the agenda
for the last three years; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

78
(c) what steps have been taken so far,
to implement these vital issues?
 Vacant seats in scientific and
technological institutions
*253. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
 Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many seats
in scientific and technological institutions
have remained vacant throughout the
academic year, due to lack of eligible
candidates;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years, institution-wise; and
(c) what steps have been taken by
Government to fill up such vacancies?
 Fund for upliftment of minorities
*254. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has decided to
set up a fund for upliftment of minorities
in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any guidelines for spending
the money from the fund have been
prepared; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Menace of drug addiction
*255. SHRI ABDUL W AHAB
PEEVEE: Will the Minister of SOCIAL
JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
growing menace of drug addiction in the
country, particularly among the student
community;
(b) if so, whether any nation-wide
survey in this regard has been conducted;
(c) the particulars of existing drug de-
addiction centres in various States,
particularly in Kerala; and
(d) the grant-in-aid provided to each
such centre, particularly in Kerala, during
the last three years, year-wise?
 Expenditure on SC/ST welfare
*256. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL  JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that ever since
UPA Government assumed power in 2004,
the total expenditure on welfare of SCs and
STs has not been more than one per cent of
the total allocation in any of the past four
budgets; and
(b) whether the CAG Report for
2006-07 has revealed that even this parltry
allocation for SC/ST welfare is misused,
especially in upgrading their educational
level, causing widening of the gap in the
Gross Drop-out Rate and Gross Enrolment
Rate between SC/ST and general category
students?
 Policy for mega power projects
*257. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has formulated a policy for mega power
projects, wherein they would be entitled
for customs duty exemption on project
imports, a 10 year income tax holiday and
deemed export status; and

79
(b) if so, the details thereof?
 Improving Government schools
†*258. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: W ill the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the standard
of education in Government schools is not
at par with that of private schools;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
donation is taken in private schools; and
(c) if so, whether any policy would be
formulated for improving Government
schools, so that the problem of taking
donation by private schools could be
checked?
 Wastage of food items
*259. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there has
been a wastage of perishable food items to
the tune of Rs. 50,000 crore every year,
due to lack of proper food processing
facilities in the country;
(b) if so, whether steps have been taken
to reduce the above wastage;
(c) if so, whether the steps include
advising the States to come up with a food
processing policy and support the industry
to develop;
(d) if so, how many States have taken
initiatives in this direction and the outcome
thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons why States have
not evinced interest in promoting the
industry?
 Power-cuts in Delhi
*260. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that vast area of
Delhi experienced blackout for about seven
hours from six am to one pm and then till
night, off and on, on the 6th, 8th and 11th
February, 2008 for long hours;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the number of serious power
breakdowns for two hours and more, that
occurred in Delhi during 2007 and so far,
this year;
(d) whether performance of the
distribution companies has been evaluated
in the light of these serious breakdowns;
and
(e) if so, the outcome thereof and the
action taken or proposed to be taken to
improve the situation?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 11th March, 2008 Secretary-General.
Phalguna 21, 1929 (Saka)
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Food Processing Industries : 259,
Human Resource Development : 243, 250, 253, 258,
Law and Justice :—
Mines :—
Minority Affairs : 254,
New and Renewable Energy :—
Power : 241, 251, 257, 260,
Social Justice and Empowerment : 242, 245, 246, 252, 255, 256,
Tribal Affairs : 244,
Women and Child Development : 247, 248, 249.
80
